items.title: Rock 'em, sock 'em: Boston's Tanner Jeannot and Winnipeg's Tyrel Bauer square off in lengthy fight
items.author: KEN POWTAK
items.description: BOSTON (AP) — Boston’s Tanner Jeannot and Winnipeg’s Tyrel Bauer squared off at center ice in the first period on Wednesday night and put on one of the longest fights seen in the NHL in a while.The 6-foot-3 Bauer and the 6-2 Jeannot dropped the gloves near the center circle, then circled for about 20 seconds, looking for the right moment to make their move, before throwing more than 40 punches over nearly a minute in the Jets’ 4-2 victory over the Bruins.
